INSERT INTO "conversation_tool_call_execution" ( "creator_id", "modifier_id", "round_id", "turn_id", "call_order", "tool_call_id", "type", "tool_name", "arguments", "tool_key", "status", "result_content", "result_content_parts", "raw_result", "error_message", "start_time", "end_time" ) VALUES
( #{item.creatorId}, #{item.modifierId}, #{item.roundId}, #{item.turnId}, #{item.callOrder}, #{item.toolCallId}, #{item.type}, #{item.toolName}, #{item.arguments}, #{item.toolKey}, #{item.status}, #{item.resultContent}, CAST(#{item.resultContentParts} AS JSONB), #{item.rawResult}, #{item.errorMessage}, #{item.startTime}, #{item.endTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT round."round_number" AS "roundNumber", turn."turn_number" AS "turnNumber", execution."call_order" AS "executionOrder", execution."tool_call_id" AS "toolCallId", execution."tool_name" AS "toolName", execution."tool_key" AS "toolKey", execution."arguments" AS "arguments", execution."status" AS "status", execution."result_content" AS "resultContent", execution."error_message" AS "errorMessage" FROM "conversation_tool_call_execution" execution INNER JOIN "conversation_turn" turn ON turn."id" = execution."turn_id" INNER JOIN "conversation_round" round ON round."id" = turn."round_id" WHERE round."conversation_id" = #{conversationId} AND round."deleted" = FALSE ORDER BY round."round_number", turn."turn_number", execution."call_order"
